meaning: Each unimplemented OpenCode-mapped acquisition route appears once. These are route dispositions, not 58 distinct missing provider capabilities. Source/auth inventory is pinned in parity.json; source-backed implementation still requires endpoint and fixture review. Stored connection ID is not permission proof.

storedCredentialCandidate.meaning: A distinct balance, quota, spend or usage fact may be obtainable using an exact selected OpenCode key or OAuth connection. Endpoint permission/audience, plan and region must be checked; no live compatibility claim.

privilegedOrPlatformCredential.meaning: Distinct account billing/usage capability, but ordinary inference keys do not prove admin, management, organization, cloud-monitoring or enterprise authorization. Needs opt-in account/project/team selection and an appropriate adapter.

separateAccountSession.meaning: Distinct subscription, billing or console capability requires an explicitly selected cookie, browser, CLI, Oasis or console session. An OpenCode inference key is not a substitute. No live browser/CLI credentials were inspected.

alternativeAcquisition.meaning: Alternate acquisition of an already implemented quota or the same provider capability through another source. Not mandatory for credential-only coverage; re-evaluate if source reports an additional distinct fact.

auxiliaryOrNonQuota.meaning: Discovery/probe/local estimate rather than authoritative usage or a new quota pool. Track separately from quota coverage.

qwencloud.needed: Verify whether Qwen Cloud subscription and Alibaba Coding/Token Plan share account and pool; API key is not cookie auth.

factory.needed: Bundled Factory integration exists, but verify Droid account/product and a catalog model-provider account mapping before counting it.

antigravity.auth: IDE language server, agy CLI or Google OAuth
antigravity.needed: Google model API and Antigravity IDE account entitlement are not proven equivalent; no IDE login acquisition is implied.

nous.needed: No pinned OpenCode model provider/account binding; a custom provider would require explicit account identity.

replicate.needed: No pinned model-provider binding; web spend needs a separate session even if an inference integration is possible.

typesafe.needed: No pinned model-provider binding; browser credit account is separate until verified.
